note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 3.1 and HEAD code (coa.go sendResponse). TestRFC5176ProxyStateReturnedUnmodified verifies two Proxy-State attributes return unmodified in arrival order on Disconnect and none are invented when absent. TestRFC5176StateAndClassUnmodifiedProxyStateOpaque verifies CoA-ACK echoes State and an attribute-shaped Proxy-State byte-equal, Disconnect-ACK echoes a 253-byte all-values Proxy-State and 0xaa byte-equal with identical outcomes and two teardowns, and Class is never returned altered. TestRFC5176ProxyStateContentIsNeverRead verifies a Proxy-State encoding a live Acct-Session-Id TLV beside an unknown session produces the identical Disconnect-NAK and Error-Cause with zero teardowns.
